mapper.insert: insert into category (id, name, type, sort, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{id}, #{name}, #{type}, #{sort}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM category
AND type = #{type}
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
ORDER BY sort
